description: Permanently delete a doc the user OWNS — removes the document, its share link(s), all view/analytics data, chat, comments, suggestions, collaborators, and the stored file. IRREVERSIBLE. Only the owner can delete. Confirm with the user before calling if there's any ambiguity. Identify the doc via `doc_name` (fuzzy-matched) or `slug`.

account.description: Email address of the farm to act on. Omit for the signed-in farm. Only a connected account is accepted; call list_accounts to see which.

doc_name.description: Name of the doc to delete.

slug.description: Share-link slug or full URL. Alternative to doc_name.

name: delete_doc
title: Delete a doc
